rapport_notes: Listened well to an unusual situation (moving parents' large home worth of two small bedrooms) and calibrated accordingly.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Let's talk about your mo[ve]. What are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?" - asked right after the time check, before logistics probing
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's core fear ("I don't want to get charged for moving an entire house") got only a brief reassurance about time-based billing, no follow-up question

top_strength: Correctly calibrated the final estimate to the customer's actual small move despite the address showing a large home, directly addressing her stated fear of being overcharged.
coaching_note: When the customer raised her core concern (fear of paying for a full-house move) right at the open, the rep reassured her but didn't ask a follow-up to fully unpack it before pivoting to logistics.
